The institutional investor held 124,254 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $20.85 million, up from 11,256 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Aspiriant Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $906.50 billion market cap company.
